ابتسرن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَسَرْنَ (ibtasarna) /ib.ta.sar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# اُبْتُسِرْنَ (ubtusirna) /ub.tu.sir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# اِبْتَسِرْنَ (ibtasirna) /ib.ta.sir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
